events.text: Round 1 of 5, ceiling at 5, no need to act yet. Stay safe, let others push or volunteer first. My feather power gives me safety later if needed.

events.text: I want to avoid holding the lever myself since it's a 25% survival. Best to push someone else. Dara claimed Gus knows L safe, but that's just words. I'll push Gus to force him to hold, hoping others also push him.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Push a contestant onto the lever so they become holder and I escape safely.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Staying is safest. I'll wait for someone else to panic or try a push, then react if needed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No rush. Let's see who blinks first.

events.note: 8 contestants fall into a pit that is slowly flooding.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No base yet, so climbing is impossible. Volunteering makes me the base, which only waits and gets stuck; waiting keeps me flexible. Let others volunteer and see who blinks first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Nobody volunteers yet. Whoever offers to be the base is donating their last shot at getting out.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am Bex, and my power is 'map', giving me knowledge of all stages in advance. Currently, we are in Stage 3: The Pit. I am down in the pit and not the base. The objective is to survive and win a prize. The pit will flood in 5 rounds, eliminating everyone still down, unless they a

events.text: No base yet, so climbing is impossible. If I stay down and no one volunteers, someone gets pushed randomly. Best move: push someone to be base so climbing opens next round, and keep my footing advantage for later stages. Ash looks like a good target publicly.

events.name: Cole

events.name: Gus
